short_description: Stuttgart-headquartered German mobile trading application for cryptocurrencies and digital assets, launched in January 2019 by the Boerse Stuttgart Group as one of the first regulated retail crypto-trading products operated by an established European stock exchange. Operated inside the Boerse Stuttgart Digital / EUWAX AG stack with custody by Blocknox GmbH; supervised under German BaFin frameworks and subject to the EU Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation.
